contentPattern.structure: circular icon + short product label (whole card links to product page)

suitableFor: product/category navigation grids where each tile is an icon + short label linking to a landing page
compact icon-driven link grids (insurance products, service categories)
sets of many uniform clickable tiles with no description text
notSuitableFor: photo teaser cards with a heading + description + read-more link (use cards-teaser)

usage.notes: Admiral homepage 'product pods' grid: 12 insurance product tiles (Car, Home, Pet, MultiCover, MultiCar, Van, Travel, Personal loans, Learner, Landlord, Temp car, Breakdown). Icon-only cards (inline SVG), no body description, whole tile is the link.
